title: Can ERPNext Send Available Items with Images via WhatsApp?

posts.cooked:
Hi Community,

We are working on an ERPNext implementation for a saree business. The client has a requirement to send the list of available sarees (items that are in stock only) along with their images to customers via WhatsApp.

We are considering using the WhatsApp Cloud API or any third-party integration (like Twilio, WATI, Gupshup) for this.

Here’s what we want to achieve:

  • Only items that are currently in stock (stock > 0) should be included
  • Each item should include:
    • Item name
    • Price
    • Quantity available
    • Item image
  • The message should be sent to the customer’s WhatsApp from ERPNext (maybe via a custom button or scheduled job)

Has anyone done something similar?

  • Is this achievable using custom scripts in ERPNext?
  • Are there any existing apps or plugins that can help with this?
  • Any suggestions or best practices for integrating with WhatsApp in this use case?

Looking forward to your advice and suggestions!

Thanks in advance
Gowthami
